_key.description: PharmGKB variant annotation ID and drug accession joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Source for the variant to drug edge

_to.description: Target for the variant to drug edge

gene_symbol.description: Gene symbol for the variant to drug edge

pmid.description: PMID for the variant to drug edge

study_parameters.description: Study parameters for the variant to drug edge, from PharmGKB's study_parameters.tsv

study_type.description: Type of study (e.g. cohort, case/control, trio)

study_cases.description: Number of study cases. Stored as a string as provided by the source, may be empty

study_controls.description: Number of study controls. Stored as a string as provided by the source, may be empty

p-value.description: Reported p-value operator and number as a single string (e.g. "= 0.49"), not a float. Null when the source row is malformed

phenotype_categories.description: Phenotype categories for the variant to drug edge

name.description: Name for the variant to drug edge

inverse_name.description: Inverse name for the variant to drug edge

source.description: Source for the variant to drug edge

source_url.description: Source URL for the variant to drug edge

class.description: The class of the variant to drug edge, from the associated files_filesets record

method.description: The method of the variant to drug edge, from the associated files_filesets record

files_filesets.description: The files filesets of the variant to drug edge

accessible_via.return: _from, _to, gene_symbol, pmid, study_parameters, phenotype_categories, source, source_url, class, method, files_filesets
